newsitem.title: EU: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, SEPT 9 - SUNDAY, SEPT 15.
newsitem.headline: EC REPORT WEEKLY DIARY FOR MONDAY, SEPT 9 - SUNDAY, SEPT 15.

text.p: HIGHLIGHTS
BRUSSELS - EU Monetary Committee meets (Monday-Tuesday); main discussions on new ERM, budgetary stability pact and legal framework for the Euro.
BRUSSELS - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (Wednesday); discussions on communication on public services and indicative nuclear programme under article 40 of the Euratom treaty.
HELSINKI - The Socialist Group holds special meeting (Wednesday-Friday); discussions include progress of the IGC; common foreign and security policy.
MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 9
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Brittan attends single currency seminar. Venue: European Parliament.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer attends world conference on law. Venue: Palais des Congres.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner de Silguy meets Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt; meets World Bank Vice President for External Affairs Mark Malloch-Brown.
BRUSSELS - EU Monetary Committee meets (and Tuesday); main discussions on new ERM, budgetary stability pact and legal framework for the Euro.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
- (1500/1300 GMT) Foreign Affairs - Irish Foreign Minister Dick Spring attends;
Social Affairs;
Civil Liberties;
Rules of Procedure;
Women's Rights.

BRUSSELS (MODIFIED ITEM) - European Newspaper Publishers Association (ENPA) conference on "Journalists and the world of politics, publishers and politicians" has been CANCELLED, no date available yet.
MADRID (NEW ITEM) - NATO Secretary General Javier Solana on official visit; meets Foreign Minister Abel Matutes (1215/1015 GMT) and Defence Minister Eduardo Serra (0900/0700 GMT).
TUESDAY, SEPTEMBER 10
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission President Santer and Commissioner Brittan attend "EU/Japan journalists" conference. Venue: Borschette Centre.
EDINBURGH - European Commission's DG XVI, Committee of the Regions and Scotland hold conference on land-use planning in the North Sea and Baltic regions.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - Following EP committees meet:
- (0900/0700 GMT) Foreign Affairs;
Social Affairs;
Rules of Procedure.

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds seminar on "NATO enlargement" (1315/1115 GMT). Speaker is Andras Simonyi, Ambassador and Head of Hungarian Liaison Mission with NATO and the Western European Union. Venue: Place du Congres, 1. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
BUCHAREST - Council of Europe and council for national minorities of Romania's government holds third annual meeting on "Governments and minorities" (and Wednesday).
WEDNESDAY, SEPTEMBER 11
BRUSSELS (MODIFIED ITEM) - European Commission holds regular weekly meeting (0930/0730 GMT).
Provisional agenda includes:
- European Commission President Santer communication on public services.
- Commissioner Christos Papoutsis presents communication on nuclear industries in the EU - indicative nuclear programme under article 40 of the Euratom treaty COM(96)339.

- Commissioner Martin Bangemann presents communication on the proposal for an EP and Council directive on the application to voice telephony of the principle of open network provision and universal service for telecoms in a competitive environment.
- Commissioner Sir Leon Brittan presents communication on the second phase of the integration of textile and clothing products under GATT is POSTPONED no new date available.
- Commissioner Bjerregaard presents communication on production quotas for HCFCs is POSTPONED no new date available.
- Commissioner Neil Kinnock presents communication on an internal market in aviation is POSTPONED no new date available.

- Commission President Jacques Santer and Commissioners Yves-Thibault de Silguy and Mario Monti present communication on the legal framework for the use of the Euro is POSTPONED no new date available.
- Commission President Santer and Commissioner de Silguy present communication on Commission proposal on a budgetary stability pact is POSTPONED no new date available.
- Commissioner de Silguy presents communication on foreign exchange in the EU is POSTPONED no new date available.

HELSINKI (NEW ITEM) - The Socialist Group holds special meeting (1500/1300 GMT) (to Friday). Main issues discussed: progress of the IGC; common foreign and security policy. Speakers include: Finnish Premier Paavo Lipponen; Irish Foreign Minister Dick Spring; European Commissioner Liikanen and MEP Pauline Green. Venue: Helsinki University of Technology.
THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 12
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commission hosts news conference on the conservation of Brazilian tropical forests pilot programme (1600/1400 GMT). Venue: Breydel building, press room.
BRUSSELS (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Monti attends high level group meeting on fiscality.
STRASBOURG (NEW ITEM) - European Commissioner Gradin attends seminar on the national and European ombusdmen's role in the supervision of the application of EU law. Venue: European Parliament.
BRUSSELS - Union of Industrial and Employee's Confederation of Europe (UNICE) hold press briefing on "Taxation in the EU" (1530/1330 GMT). Venue: UNICE, rue Joseph II. Contact: UNICE (322) 231 1445.

BRUSSELS - Friends of the Earth Europe hold conference on "International biosafety" (and Friday). Topics include: the EU and international biosafety actions; experiences with international legislation on the transfer of potentially hazardous substances; north-south transfer of genetically modified organisms; legal instruments to be included in an international biosafety protocol, implementation and control. Venue: Palace Hotel. Contact: Friends of the Earth Europe (322) 542 0180.
FRIDAY, SEPTEMBER 13

BRUSSELS - Centre for European Policy Studies (CEPS) holds workshop on "The strategic implications of the Euro for banks and corporates" (1000/0800 GMT). Agenda includes: implication of the empirical findings on economies of scale and scope in European banking; mergers and acquisitions in European banking; European banking: a cross-country comparison; Euro pricing and marketing strategies in Europe; implications for corporate finance; place of business and taxation. Venue: Place du Congres 1. Contact: CEPS (322) 229 3911.
SATURDAY, SEPTEMBER 14
No events scheduled.
SUNDAY, SEPTEMBER 15
BARCELONA, Spain - Eurotextil exhibition on the textile and clothing industry takes place (to Tuesday). Venue: Fira de Barcelona. Contact: Eurotextil (34) 93 233 2000.

CRACOW, Poland - European Commission and the Polish government hold joint conference on "Industrial property in European integration" (1900/1700 GMT) (to Tuesday). Speakers include: Head of the Commission delegation in Poland Rolf Timans, Commission DG XV Director General John Mogg. Contact: Kserkop (48) 12 33 39 24.
